use_case: Process-optimization model recommending setpoints (jacket temperature, agitation, addition timing) for blend hall batches to cut cycle time and energy
vendor_or_model: Company-built gradient-boosted regression models on the AI/ML platform (Cloud provider A), one per plant and product family
data_categories: Historian process data; batch records; QC results (Restricted: reveals formulations and toll customer recipes); no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only: operators see recommendations on a read-only control room dashboard and enter accepted changes by hand; shift supervisor approval outside the normal operating range; no write path to any DCS
applicable_laws: EPA RMP 40 CFR 68.65, 68.69(a)(2), 68.75 (safe limits, deviations, MOC) and OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(d), (f), (l) where a plant has covered processes; C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA-led joint guidance on AI in OT, Dec. 3, 2025 (voluntary)
status: In production (advisory) at 6 plants: PLT-01, PLT-02, PLT-03, PLT-06, PLT-07, PLT-09; closed-loop pilot at PLT-01 proposed and not approved
scope_plants: PLT-01, PLT-02, PLT-03, PLT-06, PLT-07, PLT-09
safety_relevance: High: influences setpoints on blend tanks at plants with RMP processes; excluded from ammonia, chlorine, and hydrogen peroxide additions and from SIS settings
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Representativeness by plant, product family, and season; workforce fairness review of override rates (aggregate only); one product family flagged
monitoring: Weekly drift and accuracy by plant; recommendations near safe limits; override rate by plant

use_case: Predictive maintenance for pumps, compressors, and agitators from vibration and temperature data
business_owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS (mechanical integrity)
vendor_or_model: Industrial analytics vendor (SaaS) with company-tuned models
data_categories: Equipment sensor data; maintenance history; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Reliability engineers review every alert before a work order; does not replace mechanical integrity inspections
applicable_laws: EPA RMP 40 CFR 68.73 and OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(j) (inspections stay on their required schedule); vendor contract
safety_relevance: Medium: a missed alert does not reduce the required inspection frequency
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Alert precision and recall by equipment type and plant
monitoring: Monthly precision and recall; missed failures reviewed

use_case: Computer vision for PPE and exclusion-zone detection at truck racks and the marine terminal dock
vendor_or_model: Video analytics vendor running on company video servers
data_categories: Video of workers, drivers, and contractors (personal information); no audio
human_in_the_loop: Alerts go to the rack or dock supervisor, who decides; not used for discipline without human review of the footage
applicable_laws: OSHA general duty context; MTSA Facility Security Plan (33 CFR Part 105) for the dock camera use; state employee monitoring and biometric laws where the plant operates (counsel review; no face recognition used); POL-05
safety_relevance: High: a missed detection could leave a person in a loading hazard zone; false alerts could stop loading
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Detection rate by lighting, weather, PPE color, and worker height; false-alert rate by shift
monitoring: Weekly alert review by supervisors; quarterly accuracy sample

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for office productivity (drafting, summaries, search)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service in the productivity suite (company tenant, no training on company data)
data_categories: Internal documents; Confidential data allowed; Restricted data and SSI blocked by label
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; not approved for Restricted data, SSI, SDS content, or regulatory submissions
applicable_laws: POL-04 and POL-05 (internal); SSI 49 CFR Part 1520 (blocked); state breach laws if personal information were exposed
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Output quality sampling; no decisions about people
monitoring: Monthly DLP label blocks; usage reports

use_case: Safety data sheet (SDS) authoring assistant that drafts SDS sections from formulation and hazard data
business_owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS (product stewardship)
vendor_or_model: SDS authoring SaaS vendor feature (generative model)
human_in_the_loop: A qualified SDS author reviews and signs every section; the assistant cannot publish
applicable_laws: OSHA Hazard Communication 29 CFR 1910.1200(g) (SDS content; the company remains responsible); vendor contract with no-training terms
safety_relevance: High: a wrong hazard or handling statement could harm downstream users
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Error rate by section and by product family; second-author review of 10% of SDSs
monitoring: Monthly error sampling; vendor model change notice

use_case: SOC alert triage assistant (IT and OT alerts)
data_categories: Security logs, including OT DMZ logs; some user identifiers
human_in_the_loop: Analysts decide on every alert; the assistant only summarizes and ranks
status: In production (enabled in a 2026-05 vendor release)
safety_relevance: Low: analysts still review OT alerts; must not auto-close OT alerts
monitoring: SOC quality review of auto-ranked alerts

use_case: SL-1 telemetry anomaly detection and tank runout prediction for automatic replenishment
vendor_or_model: Company-built models on Cloud provider B
data_categories: Tank levels; site and order history; business contact data
human_in_the_loop: Replenishment orders validated against site limits; account teams call critical water utility sites
safety_relevance: Medium: a missed runout at a water utility could affect drinking water treatment
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Accuracy by customer segment (water utilities vs industrial) and sensor type
monitoring: Weekly missed-runout review; monthly accuracy by segment

use_case: QC laboratory spectral model that predicts pass or fail for incoming raw materials
data_categories: Spectra; lot data; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: An analyst confirms every predicted fail and a 10% sample of predicted passes with the reference method
applicable_laws: Customer quality agreements; SL-2 Processing Integrity commitments (P09)
safety_relevance: Low to medium: an off-spec raw material could cause an off-spec batch
bias_or_representativeness_testing: Accuracy by supplier and material grade

use_case: ERP demand forecasting feature for production planning
data_categories: Order history; customer demand; no personal data
status: In production (enabled in a 2026-04 vendor release)

applicable_laws: Federal equal employment opportunity laws (Title VII adverse impact analysis by counsel); state AI and employment laws in each state where applicants reside (counsel review)
